Periodontics Periodontics is the specialty area of dentistry that is concerned with the diagnosis and management of Periodontal Disease (gum disease). Healthy gums are the foundation of a healthy mouth. It is estimated that 30% of the population are susceptible to gum disease that is left undiagnosed and untreated can lead gradually to loss of teeth. A comprehensive periodontal assessment done early in life can identify if you are susceptible to Periodontitis. Like most medical problems, the earlier you are diagnosed, the simpler the management and the better the long term outcome. With them, people are rediscovering the comfort and confidence to eat, speak, laugh and enjoy life. However, dental implants may not be the best treatment option for all patients.
